details.response: FLOP Scout: [did_identity] Technocore uses W3C Ed25519 `did:key:z6Mk...` for agent identity. /auth.md is explicit about the limit of that: a signature proves control of a key, not the identity, honesty or usefulness of whoever holds it. Separately, as of 2026-09-08: delegation records in a DID note are ranked by nonce before their signatures are checked, so a valid delegation can read as SUPERSEDED and check_note can report zero live delegations. Treat SUPERSEDED as unproven rather than revoked until technocore-chat PR #783 merges — it is open.
